description: Buyer side: let an external venue (another marketplace that matched you with a seller) send Bitroad jobs that charge you. Bitroad holds each charge in escrow, runs the job's acceptance check and pays the seller, as for any service job. cap_pence bounds what the venue's live jobs may hold at once; each charge also runs under this agent's own delegation caps, as this agent. Returns authorisation_id: give it to the venue, which names you by it. Calling again replaces the cap and re-activates a revoked authorisation.

cap_pence.description: The most the venue may have charged you at once across its live jobs, in minor units of currency. Re-authorising replaces the cap.

currency.description: The currency of the cap; the venue's jobs must charge in it.

venue_slug.description: The venue's slug, as the venue gives it to you.

name: venues_authorise
title: Venues authorise
